PATCHPILOT / V1
Interactive public demo

HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP ENGINEERING AGENT

From bug report to
verified draft PR.

PatchPilot reproduces a small defect, proposes a bounded repair, waits for approval, runs tests, and stops at a reviewable draft pull request.

This page is an interactive product demo. The executable Python workflow, policy engine, SQLite audit store, and 11 automated tests are included in the repository.

EXPLICIT STATE MACHINE

Models propose.
Trusted code decides.

The LLM never receives GitHub credentials and cannot bypass reproduction, policy checks, tests, or approval gates.

01

INVESTIGATE

Inspect and reproduce

Read bounded repository context and run the configured baseline test. Stop if the defect is not reproducible.

02

PLAN

Explain before editing

Return a typed plan with evidence, expected files, risk, assumptions, and verification commands.

03

APPROVE

Human gate

A reviewer accepts or rejects the scope. Patch generation cannot begin before this durable decision.

04

EXECUTE

Patch and verify

Validate the unified diff, apply it in a dedicated workspace, and run the approved test command.

05

REVIEW

Check the evidence

Reject protected paths, unrelated files, oversized changes, unsafe commands, or failed regression tests.

06

PUBLISH

Second human gate

Create a draft PR only after separate approval. V1 never merges code or deploys applications.
